item.title: Djemaa el Fna
item.description: Djemaa el Fna is the central point of the medina (old city) in Marrakesh, Morocco. You can’t miss it! It’s a large open square where I bet you can find anyone and anything, from freshly squeezed orange juice to steamed sheep’s heads, from cobras dancing to flute music to a guy with a chicken on his head (a live one! … uhm … both the guy and the chicken that is 😛 ). But there’s a catch, you have to be there at the right time of day for each of the attractions! It sure changes a lot over the course of a day!
